/readme

Access denied. Signal found.

ERROR 403 is an independent audiovisual art platform based in Iran, dedicated to experimental practices at the intersection of sound, moving image, technology, and live performance.

Through audiovisual events, artistic collaborations, and interdisciplinary experimentation, the platform creates space for artists to explore new forms of expression and shared experiences beyond conventional artistic formats.

403 is the code a server sends when it refuses access. We took the refusal as our name.

USER 01 / FOUNDER

Mahshid Khalaj

Visual Artist & Interactive Designer

Mahshid Khalaj is an Iranian visual artist and interactive designer working across audiovisual performance, real-time visual systems, creative coding, and interactive media. Her practice explores the intersection of image, sound, technology, and experimental visual expression, with a focus on creating immersive and responsive experiences.

@_mah_sheed__
USER 02 / FOUNDER

Mohammadreza Haghro

Electronic Musician & Interactive Media Artist

Mohammadreza Haghro is a multidisciplinary artist working across music, interactive visuals, real-time media, and 3D environments. Combining sound, TouchDesigner, and Unreal Engine, his practice explores the relationship between audio, visual systems, and interactive spaces, creating immersive experiences at the intersection of music and digital art.
